audit.why: Difficulty 7/10 with a 51.5% win rate over 233 games is consistent: Azir out-ranges you (Conquering Sands 740 plus soldier reach) but loses any fight you reach, and Miasma denies his only escape.

Spikes recorded: your level 6 Petrifying Gaze against a champion whose only mobility (Shifting Sands, 22s rank 1) can be grounded; Tear/Lost Chapter mana spike; Seraph's + Liandry's DPS lead. Azir's own spikes are Emperor's Divide at 6 (120s rank 1) and his first item soldier range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two decisive interactions: Miasma's grounding shuts off Shifting Sands, and Shifting Sands' shield absorbs the burst you open with.
audit.why: Cassiopeia W grounds (kit flag: 'shuts off enemy dashes'); Azir E is flagged dash + shield. Emperor's Divide creates terrain that blocks your walk-up and knocks you back.
audit.corrected: Miasma under his feet denies the dash for its duration; his E shield eats your opener, so force it out before committing R.

audit.why: The field exists to hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Shifting Sands 22s rank 1 / 16s maxed; Emperor's Divide 120s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[2].d described spending his dash under a title about grounding his retreat.
audit.why: Bodies must explain their own titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten per title, grounded in Twin Fang's 40 mana cost and Miasma's grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Azir' while its own why describes you as a late hyper-carry, win[6] reads 'Cassiopeia', and the packet levelChart reads Cassiopeia for all seven rows.
audit.why: Cross-layer disagreement — the row argued with the sentence beneath it.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It governs your forward steps. - R Petrifying Gaze spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his shield-dash to a soldier absorbs your burst. Step in once it is burned. - Miasma grounds it: W his path and he stays. - Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1 — bait it, then spend your R.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Azir is executable.
edits.after: Noxious Blast first — Twin Fang costs 40 mana and only pays off on a poisoned target, so opening with E empties the bar for nothing.

edits.before: Azir spends Shifting Sands early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Miasma grounds Shifting Sands — drop it under him and the dash is dead for the cloud's duration.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Unpoisoned Twin Fang is 40 mana for chip damage; land Q first or you run dry before his 22-second Shifting Sands returns.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Azir wins by poking with soldiers at 740 range and knocking your step-in back with Emperor's Divide before fangs land.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by outliving the soldiers: ground Shifting Sands, hold Zhonya's for Emperor's Divide, then fang him down once both are spent.
